spans.note: The prompt demonstrates good tool/action safety practices. It requires comprehensive validation before generating files (Phase 2 blocker validation), runs post-generation validation checks (Phase 4 with 7 checks), verifies file integrity, validates data flow chains, and requires user confirmation before generating files. The system also has auto-fix capabilities with clear reporting of changes made.

The prompt preserves user agency well. It asks clarifying questions at each phase, requires explicit user confirmation before generating files ('Ready to generate? [y/n]'), validates the data flow with the user ('Does this flow look correct?'), and presents options clearly. The workflow is designed as a collaborative process where the user drives decisions.
